decisions.mainline: COM-HPC Mini x86 Meteor Lake-class module (ADLINK COM-HPC-mMTL-155H-32G class) for EVT
decisions.rationale: Reconciles Cont IX COM-HPC freeze; shared module across desk SKUs; avoids bare CPU BGA

decisions.mainline: COM-HPC Mini EVT mule (shared Meteor Lake-class module) for electrical/thermal bring-up
decisions.rationale: One EVT mule architecture; production handheld form-factor board remains separate
decisions.notes: Prior Radxa RM121-D8E32 retained as historical digital package; not mixed into Hardware v1 mainline BOM

decisions.mainline: Production handheld carrier/board geometry PENDING_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT after EVT mule data
decisions.rationale: Cannot freeze production board without measured thermal/power/fit from mule

decisions.mainline: IPS LCD panels (single eDP Student; dual eDP DS-XL)
decisions.rationale: Cost, brightness outdoors/desk, AVL availability; OLED isolated as experiment

decisions.mainline: M.2 NVMe storage + M.2 Key E Wi-Fi (Intel BE200 class)
decisions.rationale: Standard COM-HPC Mini IO; field replaceable

decisions.mainline: Optional Telit FN990B40-class M.2 5G Sub-6 module; Quectel RM520N-GL approved alternate
decisions.rationale: FN990B40-class named in Hardware v1 mainline; Quectel retained as AVL alternate from prior freeze
decisions.owner_gate: PENDING_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION on FN990B40 distributor SKU + antenna kit

decisions.mainline: USB4 40 Gbps (Intel JHL8440 + JHL9040R retimer) + USB-C PD EPR-class controller
decisions.rationale: Reconciles DOCK_ARCHITECTURE_FREEZE_USB4_TB4; no USB4 80 in main BOM

decisions.mainline: Nordic nRF54L15 class (BLE + LE Audio capable MCU)
decisions.rationale: Hardware v1 mainline uplift from nRF52840 digital package; nRF52840 retained as historical evidence, not mainline BOM mix

decisions.mainline: IMU + capacitive/touch + magnetic cradle charge contacts for EVT
decisions.rationale: Measurable EVT path; inductive and sEMG isolated as experiments

decisions.mainline: Vendor UEFI on COM-HPC module + Zephyr EC on companion MCU
decisions.rationale: Ship path with vendor support; open alternatives experimental

decisions.mainline: Qualified Li-ion / LiPo only; no experimental chemistries in mainline
decisions.rationale: UN38.3 / transport path; experimental chemistries deferred Gen2

decisions.mainline: IPC Class 2 baseline with selective tighter controls on BGA/COM connector / RF keepouts (not blanket Class 3)
decisions.rationale: Cost/yield vs reliability; Class 3 reserved for selective high-risk zones

decisions.mainline: Single COM-HPC Mini carrier mule + dock USB4-40 bring-up board + rings magnetic cradle EVT kit
decisions.rationale: Minimal set to unlock measured EVT without collapsing SKUs into LCD compromise
decisions.owner_gate: Owner quote + build authorization (Cursor does not purchase/RFQ-send)
